property: After faults stop and all three voters have fair communication and execution, a stable leader's committed prefix must propagate to every running follower within the declared recovery bound.
method: Require at least 100 successful post-heal commits and convergence of each follower's committed/applied prefix to the stable leader. Validate fair delivery before interpreting timeout.
witness_requirements: Divergent prefixes reached through ordinary operations, conflict responses, unchanged next replication position, healthy-period deliveries, timer progress and convergence deadline.
